review_notes: I read the whole file and checked its private definitions (A, 𝒜, P1, ev0, sK, κ, g, ψ, p, R, φ, tX) against Mathlib. The ones I checked were Proj, Proj.toSpecZero, Proj.awayι, HomogeneousLocalization.Away, Scheme.functionField, RationalMap.ofFunctionField, IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective and MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule. The file uses these Mathlib notions directly and does not rebuild them. The abbreviations A, 𝒜 and P1 are only local names. ev0 and sK are small glue maps for the closed immersion Spec K → Spec (𝒜 0), and I found no Mathlib retraction of 𝒜 0 onto K to use in their place. Mathlib's functionField file only has an Algebra instance for Spec R, not one over a general base scheme. The private κ does overlap with the project's own AlgebraicCurve.baseToFunctionField, which the file already imports and uses in valuationRing_stalk and exists_pole. That definition lives in Definitions/Def_AlgebraicCurve_CurveModel.lean, not in Mathlib, Batteries or core, so it is outside this rubric and I did not report it. I found no competing Mathlib concept that justifies a finding. The remaining uncertainty is whether a Mathlib API for a base-change map to the generic stalk exists under a name I did not search.
